clinic.pageSubtitle: Use your clinic work email and password. Access after sign-in is determined by roles.
clinic.panelSubtitle: Sign in with your work email and password. The owner role and permissions are assigned in the admin panel — a separate owner login is not required.

public.pageSubtitle: Patients use the clinic address. Staff and the owner use email and password below.
public.hintNeedClinic: Use your clinic’s sign-in link, or enter the clinic address below (the same slug as in …/c/clinic-address/…).
public.hintNeedsSlug: Patient sign-in URLs must include the clinic address: /c/your-slug/sign-in (three path segments after the domain), not /c/sign-in.
public.hintSessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again from the clinic link.
public.hintOauth: Social sign-in was cancelled or failed. Use the clinic link and phone sign-in.
public.patientsHelp: Each clinic has its own address in the link. Paste the address from the invite (the path after /c/).
public.ownerSlugHelp: Clinic owners: enter the same clinic slug used in public URLs (Settings → Clinics → edit clinic). The slug is the …/c/your-slug/sign-in segment.

founder.pageSubtitle: Separate contour and JWT. This is not organization admin sign-in.
founder.mfaHint: If 2FA is enabled, the next step asks for an authenticator code.

shell.title: Operations platform for service businesses
shell.body: Patients, clinic staff, and the platform team work in separate contours with separate tokens. The form on the right is for sign-in only.
shell.scheduleBody: Online booking, waitlists, and reminders in one system.
shell.omniBody: Client conversations, internal chat, and operational tasks.
